sentence: mirror() of a pad adds a copy of the pad at each place, and copy 1 and copy 2 of the cut overlap each other, so brep-rs cannot yet join overlapping cuts into the same single part FreeCAD gives. Add the extra pads yourself, one sketch and join(shape, pull(...)) each.
